0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Catty is looking over the food stores, her face a mask of concern.

24.original: Slay two whiptails, then defeat the enraged Jaculus.

48.original: This should be enough to last us. At least until those scaly buggers are taken care of...

49.original: These days it seems there're more pests than people living in Stilltide, what with all the hopefuls running off to Eulmore.

50.original: Those flying lizards are the worst of the lot, though. You can't even leave for an honest day's work anymore without a swarm of them flapping sky demons nipping at your heels from here to Governor's Row.

51.original: And don't get me started on their leader! “Jaculus,” we call him. With the way that vicious blighter comes after you, you'd think he bloody owns the place!

52.original: Ugh, <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> needs to topple that little tyrant. None of us fancy losing a finger, but maybe you're up to the challenge?

53.original: If you're keen to draw him out, just skewer a couple of his broodmates. That'll get his attention soon enough.

54.original: Did you say you were going to gut that territorial lizard leader for us? Like I said, just murder some of his mates, and you'll soon get an audience with Jaculus himself.

55.original: You got the bitey little bastard, then!? Shadows be praised! Now maybe we can work the fields in peace.

56.original: If you hadn't done the deed, I was afraid we'd start running out of food. And I've no wish to watch anyone starve to death...

57.original: Aye, I know we could move to Gatetown and live on handouts of meol like the rest of them, but we have our pride.

58.original: It's not like we could just move to Gatetown and live on handouts of meol anymore. Did you know that stuff was the flesh of sin eaters? <shudder> No bloody thank you.

59.original: If there's any choice in the matter, we'd rather take care of our own needs while we can...with a little help from battle-savvy travelers such as yourself, of course!
